blocker: GoHighLevel account is locked for failed payment. Alex owns reactivation.
one_sentence_goal: Every serious lead creates one visible sales record, one next action, and the correct follow-up without flooding the pipeline with cold imports.
decisions: FOUNDING STUDENTS is the customer sales pipeline.
SLM Affiliate Lifecycle is the Partner pipeline.
OUTREACH ENGINE can track partner targets. It is not the customer sales pipeline.
Bulk cold-email imports create contacts only. They never create sales opportunities.
A positive reply, trial start, calculator completion, or booked call can create the one customer sales opportunity.
Every later event updates that same open opportunity instead of creating another one.
GHL authenticated views are the MVP dashboard because they are private, maintainable, and already connected to the records.
Routine success appears on the dashboard. Only events requiring a person or an exception send an alert.

provider_discovery.help_io: No current project definition or integration for help.io was found. It remains one focused clarification and is not an MVP dependency.

mvp_build_order.name: Booked Call core
mvp_build_order.scope: Test and publish S1, S2, and S3. Prove booking, held, and no-show update one opportunity.

mvp_build_order.name: Cold reply intake
mvp_build_order.scope: Normalize the confirmed sender's positive reply event. Create or update one contact, one Founding Students opportunity at In Chase, and one Alex task. Bulk import remains contact-only.

mvp_build_order.name: Call outcome control
mvp_build_order.scope: Add one Call Outcome field. Alex selects Held, No-show, Follow-up, Won, or Lost/Not Yet. Follow-up requires a due date. The field moves the same opportunity and creates the next task.

mvp_build_order.name: Trial Day 5 action
mvp_build_order.scope: At trial day 5, recheck eligibility. If no Blueprint Call is booked, create one Alex task and send one actionable alert. Booked, purchased, ended, or ineligible trials are suppressed.

mvp_build_order.name: Influencer gift action
mvp_build_order.scope: When an influencer receives an SLM product, create one Mia task named Send handwritten email and one notification. Track completion. Do not auto-send the email.

mvp_build_order.name: Partner operating board
mvp_build_order.scope: AF1 creates or updates one Partner opportunity. AF2 moves it to Affiliate Signed Up. Partner onboarding booking moves the same record to Affiliate Onboarding Call.

mvp_build_order.name: Private daily dashboard
mvp_build_order.scope: Create saved GHL views for Alex's tasks, upcoming calls, unresolved outcomes, no-shows, trial Day 5, Mia influencer tasks, Partner stages, and failures.

mvp_build_order.name: Thinkific activation view
mvp_build_order.scope: Show this week's cohort, true first logins, non-login names and waiting time, and access failures. Never count access granted as a login.

dedupe_rules: One open Founding Students opportunity per contact and current On-Demand Revenue Engine sales motion.
Search by email first. Use external lead ID as the secondary identity. Never use name alone.
Every event stores its external event ID. If no event ID exists, use source plus contact ID plus event type plus source timestamp.
No-show identity is Appointment ID plus No-show status plus source timestamp.
Rebooking ends the active recovery, but a later separate no-show can start one new recovery.
Purchase, opt-out, cancellation, disqualification, and trial end stop or branch the relevant follow-up.
Replies pause automated follow-up and create a human task.

tests: Bulk cold import
100 contacts create 100 contacts and zero Founding Students opportunities.
Positive reply
One positive reply creates or updates one opportunity at In Chase, one task, and one alert. Sender sequence pauses.
Repeat reply
A second reply updates the same opportunity and does not create another open task for the same unresolved reply event.
Booked call
A fresh booking produces one opportunity at Call Booked, one appointment ID, and no duplicate.
Held call
Marking Showed moves the same opportunity to Call Held. Calendar end time alone does nothing.
No-show
Confirmed no-show starts E2 once and moves the same opportunity to In Chase.
Cancellation
Cancelled appointment never starts E2 and never receives a no-show tag.
Rebooking
Rebooking stops active no-show recovery. A later distinct no-show can start one new recovery.
Trial Day 5
An eligible trial with no booked call creates one Alex task and one alert.
Trial suppression
Booked, purchased, ended, or ineligible trials create no Day 5 task.
Existing active trials
A bounded backfill creates at most one task per eligible trial and does not flood alerts.
Influencer gift
One gifting event creates one Mia task and one notification. Repeat processing of the same event creates nothing.
Partner application
AF1 creates one Partner opportunity. AF2 and onboarding move the same record.
Thinkific activation
Access granted and first login stay separate. Unknown login data displays unavailable, never zero.

definition_of_done: Built: the saved live GHL structure exists.
Codex tested: a fresh controlled test produced the expected contact, opportunity, task, tag, message, and stop behavior.
Alex tested: Alex physically repeated the journey and confirmed the customer experience.
Live: the tested workflow is published and its first real event is visible in execution logs.
100% complete: Built, Codex tested, Alex tested, Live, and the full journey has no duplicate or missing handoff.
